0:
apex coredns-k8s-gateway.networking
ttl 300
resources Ingress Service HTTPRoute TLSRoute DNSEndpoint
gatewayClasses internal-gateways

name suffix .in-addr.arpa. .in-addr.arpa.
answer name auto
answer value (.*)\.cluster\.local\. {1}.cluster.local

while sleep 10 ; do
  date
  connections="$(netstat -n | grep :2049)"
  if [[ -n "$${connections}" ]] ; then
    echo "nfs mounted"
    curl -s -X POST "https://$${HASS_HOST}/api/webhook/serpentine_nfs_mounted"
  else
    echo "nfs unmounted"
    curl -s -X POST "https://$${HASS_HOST}/api/webhook/serpentine_nfs_unmounted"
  fi
done
